name: Devastator "Brimstone" Shotgun
description: Kastak Arms’ Devastator is a semi-automatic electric shotgun capable of delivering sustained medium range, high-impact plasma blasts for close combat, room clearances and other combat operations. If the situation requires a high-power presence, look no further than the Devastator. The "Brimstone" special edition features a bold red top-trim and a dark gray finish on the lower half of the weapon.
